crossRefs.note: Jacob heard Laban’s sons’ words, saying, “Jacob has taken away all that was our father’s. He has obtained all this…
Thus God has taken away your father’s livestock, and given them to me.
That day, he removed the male goats that were streaked and spotted, and all the female goats that were speckled and…
Listen, daughter, consider, and turn your ear. Forget your own people, and also your father’s house.

translations.web: For all the riches which God has taken away from our father are ours and our children’s. Now then, whatever God has said to you, do.”
translations.bsb: Surely all the wealth that God has taken away from our father belongs to us and to our children. So do whatever God has told you.”
translations.kjv: For all the riches which God hath taken from our father, that is ours, and our children's: now then, whatsoever God hath said unto thee, do.
translations.asv: For all the riches which God hath taken away from our father, that is ours and our children's: now then, whatsoever God hath said unto thee, do.
